description: Synthetic fixtures for protocol checks and initial ablation; not real-user quality evidence. Ground truth never enters model prompts.

pages.text: Study notes: Accuracy is correct predictions divided by all predictions. Compare methods using the same held-out set. The experiment and Figure 3 are on later selected pages.

Experiment protocol: Both methods use the same held-out test set containing 100 examples. Training size is 800. Neither method sees held-out answers during training. Hyperparameters were selected using a separate validation set. The improved method adds retrieval; no other ablation was run.

Figure 3. Accuracy comparison of Baseline and Method. The numeric bar labels and axis are embedded in the image and are absent from extracted text. Only one random seed was tested; no error bars are available.

Limitations: no latency, token usage, monetary cost, robustness evaluation or cross-domain test was measured. Correlation does not establish which component caused a gain. Claims outside this experiment need further evidence.
